summary: Answered the gap the knowledge correction registered under the recovery-authority question, with the basis verified line by line in the fixed source: handlePrepareReply's mismatched-ballot branch is `lb.nacks++; return` with no repair call (epaxos/epaxos.go:1216-1219), so a recovery whose answers all report a higher stored ballot never reaches the SlowQuorumSize guard and selects no sub-case; the makeBallot-plus-bcastPrepare restarts exist only in the proposal-phase handlers (handlePreAcceptReply lines 859-868, handleAcceptReply lines 1021-1032), each inside `if r.IsLeader`, with makeBallot's climb gated the same way (lines 439-451) and IsLeader false in epaxos.New unless the master's BeTheLeader runs (lines 149-165, 1121-1125). The revision therefore stands with its conclusion unchanged and now resting on two independent source facts, consistent with the retained receipts where the blocked attempts emitted nothing (indices 20 and 25 of receipt 911d45335b3047178a6fd739f24b2cfb and index 12 of receipt c342db60ffff4e42889bf53646049491). That closes the correction's follow-up: the run now holds five questions - four explained with executed or source-verified bases and one whose suspicion is refuted - three asserted defects each backed by receipts with declared comparisons, one holds account for the client-completion protection, seven behaviors plus one Fact carrying their evidence and conditions, and no open necessary gaps; the standing limits remain the single configuration and instance exercised, the harness's explicit delivery and direct entry-point calls, and the reachability condition that a peer of the instance must fail for the accept broadcast to reach a replica that never pre-accepted.
